message:
Amara, Baraka and Dalia, my scope is box, frame and crate layout for one tonne.

Chamber is bolt-together insulated box for cooperative assembly and move. Standard 960 millimetres wide PU sandwich panels in (E33) lock by hand with no welding. Inner space 2.4 by 2.0 by 2.2 metres high gives 10.6 cubic metres inner volume in (E44), small bedroom scale. Produce fills only 27 percent so air moves, matching fan flow in (E32).

Box sits on raised steel base carrying roof solar rails. Base uses coated steel ground-mount type in (E41) with corner posts, roof rails and ground anchors. 800 millimetre hinged door with seals and rain canopy passes person carrying 600 millimetre crate, as drawn in (E45).

One tonne rides low and spread with no point load. 52 ventilated crates at 20 kilogrammes each with 600 by 400 millimetre footprint in (E36) sit on two side racks with central aisle. Floor pressure 2.04 kilopascals from one tonne in (E43), one tenth person standing, so ordinary floor panels with spreaders carry it. I am not ready, because door seal and rack fixing with Dalia remain to fix.
